evidence_level: exposed dose development and hypothetical prospective design
qualification: Corrected sciPlex source checksum, CC-BY-4.0, metadata-only exact 24 hour nM grid and line/plate controls before response access
selection: First 24 lexicographic compounds present at all four doses in A549, K562 and MCF7; no response-based selection
hypothesis: A source-selected smooth log-dose response map improves over dose-independent means and nearest-dose transfer
allowed_information: Known compounds and states, other-dose single outcomes, exact dose, query vehicle controls; held-dose responses excluded globally from fitting, scaling, selection and pretraining
preprocessing: 512 control-selected human genes; per-cell human UMI normalization to 10000 and log2(1+x), equal well means, matched line/plate vehicle subtraction; query-control gene adaptation declared
splits: Four global outer dose holdouts; leave-one-dose-out inner selection on remaining three doses, pooled over line/plate/compound profiles; 100 and 1000 nM interpolation, 10 and 10000 nM extrapolation
endpoint: Equal-profile gene MSE, paired reduction against source-selected zero/mean/nearest; interpolation and extrapolation reported separately
decision_rule: 5% relative MSE reduction and positive conditional compound-bootstrap 95% lower bound; development only, no state or culture confirmation

power_simulation.scope: Sensitivity only; no variance fitted from technical halves, no empirical sample size recommendation
power_simulation.sampling: Crossed random effects in paired normalized loss differences, shared control within state/culture, globally shared intervention and pair effects; known-variance Gaussian lower bound for sensitivity only
power_simulation.gate: Observed normalized mean >=0.05 and one-sided 95% lower bound >0; broad-state claim also requires multiple sealed states
